YouTuber Dhruv Rathee Returns to India, CJP Protest Mentioned

YouTuber Dhruv Rathee has returned to India, with reports mentioning his presence in Delhi and a statement made near India Gate. The coverage also references a protest by the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) and a podcast by Sushant Sareen discussing these events, including a tweet by Elon Musk.
